summary.business_type: Direct-to-consumer coffee and beverage ecommerce with Bengaluru production/local-business presence
top_findings: Critical public debug endpoint exposes production payment/database information and writes to the database
Canonical URLs are absent across measured public pages and products
Shop product discovery and pagination depend on client JavaScript
quick_wins: Noindex checkout, success, admin login, and admin reset
Generate robots.txt and a complete XML sitemap
Add Product, Offer, Breadcrumb, and Organization structured data
Add accurate images to the nine image-less products

findings.title: Public debug endpoint exposes production data
findings.description: The public diagnostic endpoint emits secret-derived payment data, database URL and pending-order information, and performs a database write on GET.
findings.recommendation: Remove or authenticate the endpoint, rotate the Razorpay secret, review logs, and remove all sensitive output/write behavior.

findings.title: Robots and sitemap files are missing
findings.recommendation: Add Next.js robots.ts and sitemap.ts using the chosen production hostname.

findings.title: Catalog discovery depends on JavaScript
findings.description: Raw shop HTML exposes no product-detail anchors and pagination is button-only client state.
findings.recommendation: Server-render product anchors and implement URL-based crawlable pagination.

findings.title: Utility and authentication pages are indexable
findings.description: Checkout, success, admin login and reset have no noindex control.
findings.recommendation: Add noindex, nofollow and exclude these URLs from the sitemap.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Clear brand, location and sourcing proposition
Useful address, phone, email and hours

findings.title: Product content is thin
findings.description: 23 of 24 product descriptions are under 100 words and 16 are under 50 words.
findings.recommendation: Add truthful structured sections for ingredients, preparation, pack/servings, storage, allergens/diet, source, delivery/returns and product-specific questions.

findings.title: Claims need substantiation
findings.description: Health, nutrition, sourcing, traceability and freshness claims are not visibly supported.
findings.recommendation: Create a claim register and surface verifiable supporting evidence.

findings.title: Core ecommerce policies are missing
findings.description: No visible privacy, terms, shipping, returns/refund, payment or cancellation routes are linked.
findings.recommendation: Publish and link complete customer policy pages.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: One H1 on measured public pages

findings.title: Canonical URLs are missing
findings.description: No measured public or product page emits a canonical link.
findings.recommendation: Add metadataBase and correct self-referencing canonicals; consolidate parameter variants.

findings.title: Social metadata is absent
findings.description: Open Graph and Twitter metadata are not defined.
findings.recommendation: Add page-specific social titles, descriptions, URLs and 1200x630 images.

findings.title: Near-duplicate product families
findings.description: Four product pairs target substantially overlapping intent.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate and redirect or clearly differentiate product identity and content.

findings.title: No structured data
findings.description: No JSON-LD, Microdata or RDFa was found on public templates.
findings.recommendation: Add validated Organization/LocalBusiness, WebSite, Product, Offer and BreadcrumbList JSON-LD.

categories.name: Performance
what_works: next/image and responsive sizes are used

findings.title: Large hero media
findings.description: The hero poster is about 976 KB and hero video about 14.2 MB; several source images are 2-2.7 MB.
findings.recommendation: Resize the poster, compress/shorten video, ship mobile-aware variants, and collect real-user CWV.

findings.title: Field Core Web Vitals unavailable
findings.description: PageSpeed quota returned HTTP 429 and no CrUX/GSC access was available.
findings.recommendation: Collect 75th-percentile LCP, INP and CLS after deployment.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Specific entity, location and product facts exist
First-party sourcing and brand story content exists

findings.title: Facts lack machine-readable structure and evidence
findings.description: Thin product explanations, absent schema, unsupported claims and limited named expertise reduce citability.
findings.recommendation: Use answer-first content, consistent entity data, evidence-backed claims, named expertise and validated schema.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Public image components include alt attributes
next/image and responsive sizes are used

findings.title: Nine visible products have no image
findings.description: Nine of 24 visible catalog products have empty image arrays.
findings.recommendation: Add at least one accurate original image before indexing each sellable product.

findings.title: Large and duplicate source assets
findings.description: Multiple checked remote/local sources exceed 500 KB and the repository contains duplicate/oversized assets.
findings.recommendation: Preprocess uploads, enforce dimensions/byte limits, and remove unused delivery-path duplicates.

phases.name: Phase 0: Security incident response
items: Rotate Razorpay secret and review access logs
Remove sensitive output and diagnostic database writes

phases.name: Phase 1: Indexing foundation
items: Choose canonical production hostname and block preview indexing
Add metadataBase, canonicals and noindex controls
Server-render product links and URL-based pagination

phases.name: Phase 2: Catalog and rich results
items: Add Product/Offer/Breadcrumb and Organization/WebSite structured data
Add missing images and complete thin product content

phases.name: Phase 3: Performance and authority
items: Optimize hero poster/video and source images
Substantiate claims and add named expertise
Establish Search Console, schema validation and real-user CWV monitoring
